summary: Add trackpad pinch and modifier-scroll zoom to the PDF reader. Chromium delivers a pinch as wheel+ctrlKey and Safari as gesturestart/gesturechange; both are handled with preventDefault so the page itself never zooms, the zoom is anchored at the cursor, accumulation is measured against the last rendered scale so bursts of events do not overwrite each other, and the re-render is debounced. Toolbar buttons use the same path.
scope_note: Covers the diff since commit 2522c88. Reader UI only; no model call.

budget_impact.rationale: UI gesture handling only; no model call, no operation or ceiling change.
budget_impact.before: Zoom was available only via toolbar buttons; a trackpad pinch zoomed the whole page.
budget_impact.after: Pinch, Cmd/Option+scroll and Safari gestures zoom the document about the cursor with a debounced re-render.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; UI gesture work, not recommendation quality

open_risks: A real trackpad pinch cannot be performed here, so the gesture behaviour is unverified (it follows the documented Chromium and Safari event shapes).
Zoom re-renders rather than transforming, so very large PDFs settle after ~140ms.
Pinching outside the pages area is ignored.
Recommendation quality remains unproven; gates stay not_run.
